description: This file is a Java source code defining a Spring Boot REST controller named UserController. It handles HTTP requests related to user operations, such as reading user details and listing users, by delegating to a UserService.

classes.name: UserController
classes.description: A REST controller for user-related endpoints, handling HTTP GET requests to retrieve individual or paginated lists of users.
